component.name: Yoink
component.summary: A drag and drop shelf at the edge of your screen

description.p: Yoink is a small, native shelf for the edge of your desktop. Drag files, folders, text, links, and images onto it and they stay within reach until you need them.
Items can be dragged out again with normal copy or move semantics. Yoink never deletes or modifies the original content merely because it was collected.
